name: half-time-backbeat
description: Snare on beat 3 only (0-indexed 2) — the half-time feel: the backbeat arrives once per bar instead of twice, halving the perceived tempo. Common in hip-hop, trap, doom/sludge and breakdown sections. NOTE: a full backbeat bar also satisfies this pattern (beat 3 is struck in both); read the two coverages together — half-time is indicated when THIS matches and `backbeat` does not.
